integrity: The all-parameter theorem follows by induction, not extrapolation from experiments. Exact finite dynamic-programming checks and two sequence generators are reproducible in verify.py. The scientific review is not independent.
scientific_limitations: Only full iteration blocks mu_r^k(1) with integers r>=1 and k>=2. Not arbitrary factors, intermediate prefixes, or longer minimal absent subsequences. Generic equivalences in incompletely indexed literature are a residual originality risk.
title: Stable shortest-absent subsequence spectra of Cantor-like morphic words
